build_stacked_linear_cls_head: build a StackedLinearClsHead with hidden fc layers and an output fc layer for classification
create_linear_block: create a LinearBlock with configurable linear layer, normalization, activation, and dropout
forward_stacked_head: run forward pass on StackedLinearClsHead to get classification scores from backbone features
get_pre_logits: get pre-logits features from StackedLinearClsHead by passing features through hidden layers only
init_layers_stacked_head: init layers in StackedLinearClsHead to build a sequence of LinearBlock modules
